mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained drop in the unemployment rate below 4.0% triggers a labor market tightening that reduces inflation expectations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite UNRATE falling below 4.0% (p > 0.05 in t-test).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month increase in the INDPRO index reflects robust production growth, boosting consumer demand and corporate earnings expectations, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: INDPRO's 3-month increase does not correlate with S&P 500 20d returns (Pearson r < 0.1 over 5-year window).

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent rises in quarterly GDP (GDPC1) and housing demand (HOUST) signal broad-based economic expansion, amplifying equity valuation growth and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: GDPC1 and HOUST move in opposite directions during the 5d horizon, nullifying their combined effect (correlation < 0.5).

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle, a sustained FEDFUNDS rate above 4.5% signals aggressive rate hikes, which elevates borrowing costs and reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS crosses above 4.5% but S&P 500 60d returns are negative (p < 0.05 in t-test).

mechanism_narrative: A surge in monthly employment (PAYEMS) exceeding 150,000 indicates strong labor market absorption, which reduces inflationary pressures and supports equity valuations, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: PAYEMS exceeds 150,000 but S&P 500 5d returns are negative (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous rises in production (INDPRO) and demand (RSAFS) create a virtuous cycle of supply and demand expansion, driving up corporate profits and equity valuations, which results in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: INDPRO and RSAFS rise together but their combined effect does not predict S&P 500 20d returns (IC < 0.05 over 3-year window).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month increase in quarterly GDP (GDPC1) reflects robust economic activity, boosting consumer spending and corporate earnings, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: GDPC1's 3-month increase fails to predict S&P 500 60d returns (IC < 0.03 over 5-year window).
